core_result: Unifies three quadratic-Vieta-involution frontiers across 15 machine-checked headline theorems (T1a-T3e) + master conjunction + NonVacuity + Adversarial in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 (18 audited decls, all 6 independent kernels accepted 5,012 exported decls via lake comparator --paranoid, SLSA #72728455 / Rekor 4128618149): (I) Descartes Lorentzian form, Gaussian norm (a+b)(a+c)=a^2+k^2 & BQF (T1a), self-contained zero-Mathlib Eisenstein (1844) Gauss Quadratic Reciprocity & supplementary laws (T1b), zero-Mathlib formalization of the HKRS (Annals of Math. 2024) square obstruction for the three packings (-3,5,8,8), (-7,17,12,20), (-11,21,24,28), contrasted with (-4,8,9,9), which has the same mod-24 set {0,8,9,12,17,20} and contains the square 9 (HKRS list 3n^2, 6n^2 and fourth-power obstructions for it) (T1c), octahedral 8-reflection mod-8 residue locking on (-6,10,17,40,24,17), excluding squares at two positions and twice-squares at two positions by congruence, vs. strip (0,0,1,2,2,1) (T1d; reciprocity obstructions for octahedral packings were given in arXiv:2510.21702), and exact Soddy dimension dichotomy (d-1) | 2 <=> d in {2,3} + 3D square hit 25=5^2 (T1e); (II) Abelian sandpile toppling commutativity, least action bound and uniqueness of legal stabilizing traces, without a termination theorem (T2a), det(L_2x2) = 192 and, for the 3x3 grid, a kernel-checked integer similarity to a block-diagonal matrix whose block determinants multiply to 100,352 (the 9x9 determinant and the Matrix-Tree link are not formalized), plus legal Dhar traces (T2b, with Rust/Python Bareiss det(L_{A2,2x2})=1,092, det(L_{A2,3x3})=5,393,920), a Z^2 obstruction for the isotropic case 4u = 3(x^2+y^2) + periodic with Laplacian <= 3, proved via a torus summation lemma (T2c), an elementary A2 parity lemma with no prior statement found (T2d: if an integer function u satisfies M*u = quadratic + periodic and its triangular-lattice Laplacian is at most K = (4A-2B+4C)/M, then K is even, so K=5 is excluded in this class; K=4 and K=2 are attained), and a lattice-polygon edge-normal closure identity (T2e; the Kalinin-Shkolnikov theorem is not formalized); and (III) SL2(Z) Fricke-Cohn tr/3 correspondence (T3a), pairwise coprimality, odd-prime p = 1 (mod 4) obstruction, and a zero-Mathlib formalization of Zhang's theorem (Acta Arith. 128 (2007), arXiv:math/0612620) that every even Markov number is 2 mod 32, with 2 and 34 showing the residue mod 64 is not fixed (T3b), universal Hensel sqrt(-1) mod p^k uniqueness (T3c), exchange identities for one 5-step mutation sequence on the Markov quiver, with subtraction-free numerators (coefficient positivity by inspection; Lean states positivity of values), including divisions by the non-monomial P1 and P2 specializing at (1,1,1) to (2,5,29,433,37666) (T3d), and the classical (Hurwitz 1907) n=4 coefficient classification: positive solutions exist only for a in {1,4}, with parity constraints (T3e). Paired with zero-dependency Rust (Ubuntu/Windows, Markov <= 10^7), ISO C11 ASan/UBSan + 100k fuzz, Python exact oracle + 600+ Hypothesis trials + Rust-Python differential + 8/8 (100%) killed mutants, 20/20 live Crossref/arXiv citations (0 retractions), 13-page zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room arXiv tarball, live 4-mode GitHub Pages Observatory & Blueprint, Software Heritage full snapshot swh:1:snp:5dac6e269ff3c673fa6ee9b7520365de44109a16, and 90/90 Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
